units.source_text: 弈战中，七段频频离席解手。

en.t: During the match, the seventh-dan player repeatedly left his seat to use the restroom.

units.source_text: 在芝红叶馆开始对弈时，七段预先向名人打过招呼。

en.t: When the game began at the Shiba Koyokan, the seventh-dan player had informed the Master in advance.

units.source_text: 前次七月十六日对弈时，解手次数也很频繁，连名人都惊愕不已。

en.t: During the previous game on July 16, he had also gone to the restroom very often, leaving even the Master astonished.
